high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram Explore page, showcasing a sponsored post by the user "jubinav." The post features a person wearing a black T-shirt with a large, three-dimensional green dinosaur design on it. The dinosaur appears to be a Tyrannosaurus rex (T-Rex), with detailed textures and a glossy finish that gives it a lifelike appearance. The person in the image is standing against a plain white background, which helps to highlight the T-shirt and its design. The individual has dark hair styled neatly and is looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression.
